title: reply
description: Hub to phone: the answer to one `request` or `summarize`. The phone speaks `say` as it is, so the Provider words the whole answer, naming the Bucket where that helps.

id.description: The `id` of the request or summarize this answers. A phone ignores a reply to a request it is not waiting for.

say.description: One or two short sentences for a person, fit to be spoken.

reason.description: Absent when the command ran. Known in v1.0: `unknown_bucket` (no Bucket has that id now: its agent has gone, say), `unknown_command` (the Bucket has no such `request` command), `failed` (the Provider could not answer), `fallback` (to a `summarize`: the summariser did not answer, so `say` reads the Notes raw, and the phone does not count them as summarised). A phone speaks `say` whatever the reason, one it does not know included.
